alt: An Entire checkpoints folder holds one directory per session with full.jsonl, prompt.txt, context.md and metadata.json; process_file routes each file by name, so transcript turns, the prompt and context chunks are embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 into entire.session_embeddings while metadata.json becomes a row in entire.session_metadata; a new session picked up in live mode adds only its own rows, and the query "how did I fix the auth bug" returns the matching transcript turn with its checkpoint, session and content type.
needs: A repo where Entire captures sessions

run.note: Check out the checkpoints Entire captured (run from a repo that has them)
Build the index (add -L to keep picking up new sessions)

run.cmd: python main.py "how did I fix the auth bug"
